discrepancy_description: Train-OOF Platt calibrator slope was negative (a = -0.12 to -0.15) causing ranking inversion
impact_assessment: High - Inverted failure ranking on validation distinct raw scores
resolution_or_disposition: Documented in Workstream A audit. Negative slope was driven by Folds 0 1 2 where cross-job shift degraded raw AUC

discrepancy_description: Calibrated Brier score (0.125955) matched static constant-prevalence predictor (0.125844)
impact_assessment: High - Apparent calibration improvement was an artifact of shrinking to base rate
resolution_or_disposition: Recomputed prevalence baseline in preflight. Established that calibration did not improve discrimination

discrepancy_description: Fold 0 contained 643 windows from a single parent job with 0.93% failure rate
impact_assessment: Medium - Fold imbalance distorted pooled calibration
resolution_or_disposition: Phase 7Q implements capacity-balanced greedy assignment targeting ~10-11 parent jobs per fold

discrepancy_description: Prior relative normalizations produced extreme outliers up to +12905 due to unfloored division
impact_assessment: High - Caused gradient instability and training failure
resolution_or_disposition: Phase 7Q implements robust MAD scaling with Train-derived scale floor and [-5 +5] clipping
